edits.after: One hook at level 2 still equals a kill for his duo.

edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. The duo's tempo bends around it. - Keep R Cosmic Radiance banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: 20s at rank 1, down to 16s by rank 5 — the hook IS the champion; minion cover turns the whole lane into a farming sim. - Your R Cosmic Radiance is 180s at rank 1, 120s at rank 3 — bank it for their best play.

edits.after: Power Fist opens with a visible wind-up before the double-damage hit -- that tell is your cue to step out, not the cast.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Rocket Grab is 20s at rank 1 -- once it whiffs, Blitzcrank is defenseless for the rest of that window.
